cleanup_obfuscated_function: cleanup an obfuscated function by renaming tokens and updating the deobfuscation dictionary
build_rename_dict: build a rename dictionary mapping obfuscated tokens to sequential VAR_ FUNC_ or CLASS_ prefixed names
rename_tok: rename obfuscated tokens in a string using a provided rename dictionary
replace_function_name: replace a function name token with FUNC_0 in an obfuscated function string
read_dict: read a pipe separated deobfuscation dictionary string into a Python dictionary
